evidence: Skeime enjoyed the trial and called Ultorg great, but found its license unsuitable for occasional personal projects.

evidence_sources.author: Skeime
evidence_sources.excerpt: and it was tons of fun to use. Ultorg is great. I wish I had discovered it right at the start of that small project. Unfortunately, I do not have a regular use case for this, and for personal use and occasional unpaid hobby projects, Ultorg's license is not a good fit.

source_story_title: Ultorg: The User Interface for Relational Databases
